blocker.summary: The E2E-guarded performance probe route exposes no acknowledged revision. The unit sentence requires the acknowledged revisions to be read through it and says the unit stops at admission for a path amendment if the route needs an edit. It does, and the edit is outside e2e (the unit's only ownership path).
blocker.probeReturnsToday: src/pages-modules/api/e2ePerformanceProbeRoute.ts:53-61 answers { success, wallMs, monotonicMs, memory: { rss, heapUsed } } and nothing else (response type :23-33); src/pages/api/e2e/performance-probe.ts:7 is a one-line re-export of that handler.

exactEditsNeeded.what: Behind the existing isAuthorizedE2ERequest guard (:65-70), accept a matchId query parameter and add a read-only convergence block to the 200 body: the session's requiredRevision and, per retained participant, participantId and acknowledged revision. The smallest read needing no new session API is entry.syncSession.evaluateScenarioLaunch() (src/lib/multiplayer/server/CampaignSyncSession.ts:753-777), which answers { ok, requiredRevision } or { ok: false, requiredRevision, behind: [{ participantId, acknowledgedRevision }] } - the same answer the AdvanceDay gate reads. Its unit test is src/__tests__/api/e2ePerformanceProbeRoute.test.ts (also outside e2e).

INFERENCE (read, not run): the probe route runs in Next's API module graph, while the campaign socket handler, and so every CampaignAck, runs in the tsx graph server.js loads separately (server.js:446-464; its comment at :455-462 records that the two graphs hold separate module singletons). CampaignHostRegistry keeps its singleton in a module-level let (CampaignHostRegistry.ts:405-412), unlike MatchHostRegistry, which moved into a Symbol.for globalThis slot for exactly this reason (MatchHostRegistry.ts:220-260, comment :234-239). A probe-only edit would then read the API graph's registry, whose sessions never receive acks (bindCampaignSyncConnection.ts:220 defaults to the tsx graph's getCampaignHostRegistry()). The likely second edit holds the campaign registry in a globalThis slot as MatchHostRegistry does, or another cross-graph read the parent chooses. This path is U89's ownership path (src/lib/multiplayer/server) and would change which registry instance src/pages/api/multiplayer/matches/index.ts:325 registers into, so it is not a routine-class e2e change.

notViable: No server frame reports convergence to the GM: the campaign server message kinds are CampaignSnapshot, CampaignEvent, CampaignProposal, CampaignDecision, CampaignParticipation (src/types/multiplayer/Protocol.ts:955-994) plus Error (:807) and Close (:858); none carries acknowledged revisions.

The durable cursor campaign_participant_cursor.acked_sequence (read by src/pages-modules/api/campaignLaunchProgressionGate.ts:186-199) is not what the AdvanceDay gate reads: the socket CampaignAck case records only the in-memory retained map (bindCampaignSyncConnection.ts:619-626 -> CampaignSyncSession.ts:660-671); the durable cursor is written on the grant-ack path (src/lib/multiplayer/server/handleCampaignGrantAck.ts, src/lib/campaign/delivery/participantDeliveryCursor.ts:255-260). Waiting on it would not match the authority.
The client observer's appliedSequence is client-side receipt (spec :510-512), which is what the unit replaces.

designAnswers.probeRoute: Returns wallMs, monotonicMs, memory.rss, memory.heapUsed only (src/pages-modules/api/e2ePerformanceProbeRoute.ts:23-33, :53-61). No acknowledged revision per participant: BLOCKED (see blocker).
designAnswers.convergedMeansToTheAuthority: Only AdvanceDay is gated (bindCampaignSyncConnection.ts:748-758): refuseUnconvergedProgression (:700-718) calls entry.syncSession.evaluateScenarioLaunch() (CampaignSyncSession.ts:753-777). requiredRevision = max(0, eventLog.nextSequence() - 1), the committed head read live (:785-787). Clause refusals (branch not active, correction pending, replacement unverified) run first (:755-760). Then every RETAINED participant must have acknowledged >= requiredRevision (:761-770). Retained = non-GM members only: joinMember and retainHydratedParticipant never retain the host (:427-434, :508-531), so the GM's own acks do not count and the two guests' do. acknowledged rises only through noteParticipantAcknowledged (:660-671), called when the server dispatches the CampaignAck frame (bindCampaignSyncConnection.ts:619-626), and is refused above the participant's delivered watermark (:667). The refusal is an Error frame, code CAMPAIGN_NOT_CONVERGED, reason 'participants-behind <id>:<ack>,...; requiredRevision <N>' (CampaignProgressionGate.ts:195-206). The pack's wait must therefore be: every guest's server-recorded acknowledged revision >= the committed head, GM excluded.
designAnswers.convergeWaitToday: converge() at e2e/gm-two-player-performance.pack.spec.ts:630-646: takes the max painted head across the three pages (:631-633), polls each page's observer appliedSequence (set on frame receipt, :510-512) for up to functionalWaitMs*5 (:634-641), then waits a fixed 25 ms (:644). Call sites: :165 (before each of the 20 warm-up commands) and :198 (before each measured command). The tail builder (:268-272) does not call converge(): it issues only AllocateSalvage, which is never gated, and waits with waitForSequence on the GM page (:271). waitForSequence (:596-614) is the 2,000 ms functional wait that today reports a refused AdvanceDay as 'no painted delivery reached N' (called at :173, :206, :271).
designAnswers.gmTransportRefusal: The GM page's transport (window.__CAMPAIGN_SYNC_TRANSPORT__, src/lib/e2e/storeExposure.ts:67 -> getActiveCampaignSyncTransport, src/lib/campaign/coop/campaignSyncTransport.ts:266) hands every parsed server frame to its onFrame listeners (campaignSyncTransport.ts:182-187, :222-228), Error frames included. The refusal arrives as { kind: 'Error', code: 'CAMPAIGN_NOT_CONVERGED', reason, intentId } (bindCampaignSyncConnection.ts:708-716, errorFrame :1550-1564; schema src/types/multiplayer/Protocol.ts:806-812 carries intentId). The pack's intentId is perf-<kind>-<ordinal> (src/lib/multiplayer/performance/controlledLoopbackFixture.ts:296). A GM-page onFrame listener that records Error frames by intentId is therefore a real read of the refusal, and waitForSequence can fail naming it instead of timing out. This half needs no edit outside e2e.
